update base_patient
first_visit_date = #{basePatientInfo.firstVisitDate},
first_visit_outpatient = #{basePatientInfo.firstVisitOutpatient},
first_visit_doctors = #{basePatientInfo.firstVisitDoctors},
last_visit_date = #{basePatientInfo.lastVisitDate},
last_visit_outpatient = #{basePatientInfo.lastVisitOutpatient},
last_visit_doctors = #{basePatientInfo.lastVisitDoctors},
WHERE patient_id = #{basePatientInfo.patientId}

mapper.select: SELECT btp.treatmentId, btp.treatDate, btp.registered_dentist_id AS treatDentistId, be.employee_name AS treatDentistName, btp.org_id AS orgId, bo.abbreviation AS treatOutpatient FROM ( SELECT btp.treatmentId, DATE_FORMAT( btp1.treat_start_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) AS treatDate, btp1.registered_dentist_id, btp1.org_id FROM ( SELECT min( btp.treatment_id ) AS treatmentId FROM base_treatment_process btp WHERE btp.treat_end_time IS NOT NULL AND btp.patient_id = #{patientId} ) btp LEFT JOIN base_treatment_process btp1 ON btp.treatmentId = btp1.treatment_id ) btp LEFT JOIN base_employee be ON btp.registered_dentist_id = be.user_id LEFT JOIN base_organization bo ON btp.org_id = bo.org_id

SELECT btp.treatmentId, btp.treatDate, btp.registered_dentist_id AS treatDentistId, be.employee_name AS treatDentistName, btp.org_id AS orgId, bo.abbreviation AS treatOutpatient FROM ( SELECT btp.treatmentId, DATE_FORMAT( btp1.treat_start_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) AS treatDate, btp1.registered_dentist_id, btp1.org_id FROM ( SELECT max( btp.treatment_id ) AS treatmentId FROM base_treatment_process btp WHERE btp.treat_end_time IS NOT NULL AND btp.patient_id = #{patientId} ) btp LEFT JOIN base_treatment_process btp1 ON btp.treatmentId = btp1.treatment_id ) btp LEFT JOIN base_employee be ON btp.registered_dentist_id = be.user_id LEFT JOIN base_organization bo ON btp.org_id = bo.org_id
select bp.* from base_patient bp join base_treatment_process btp where btp.patient_id = bp.patient_id and btp.treat_end_time IS NOT NULL
